name: afl-rl-ui-tests
description: Browser-driver dependency for the two Chromium-driven UI suites in this directory (ui/tests/*.mjs). NOT a build system and NOT a package: the repo ships no JS bundler and no npm-run test lane, and the .test.js suites here are still plain `node <file>` with no dependencies at all. This manifest exists for exactly one reason — responsive_layout.test.mjs and ui_222_items.test.mjs require playwright-core, which was in NO manifest anywhere, so both suites died at import with MODULE_NOT_FOUND on any box where somebody had not installed it by hand. A dependency nobody declares is a suite that silently stops running.
_install: npm --prefix ui/tests install    (PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD=1 is the default here via .npmrc-free config: playwright-core downloads no browser of its own)
_browser: NO BROWSER IS DOWNLOADED OR VENDORED. playwright-core drives a browser it is given; the suites resolve one themselves from $CHROME_BIN, else /opt/pw-browsers/chromium-*/chrome-linux/chrome. Keep it that way — a browser binary is not repository content.
_run: node ui/tests/responsive_layout.test.mjs   ·   node ui/tests/ui_222_items.test.mjs   (both resolve playwright-core out of ui/tests/node_modules by ordinary node resolution; PLAYWRIGHT_CORE=<abs path> still overrides, unchanged)
_node_modules: ui/tests/node_modules is GITIGNORED, never committed. The lockfile beside this file is what pins the version.
